scientific_question: At the identical 147456-coordinate budget, is the fresh high-rank c_proj chart residual materially more compressible in a genuinely global orthogonal basis than in the local BlockFHT control, and is its sparse support causally reusable across phases?

theory.paper_link: Mapping Networks uses a fixed orthogonally initialized map and motivates layer-wise latent charts. The prior residual analysis shows that the production local chart leaves 72.58 percent of dense-Muon update energy in a fresh high-rank, channel-isotropic direction. This diagnostic isolates whether local BlockFHT mixing, rather than the fixed-map premise itself, explains that miss.
theory.equal_budget_rule: Identity coordinates, two-stage signflip local block-FHT256 coordinates, and a genuine global tensor-product orthogonal basis each receive exactly 147456 oracle-selected coefficients out of 2359296 ambient c_proj entries.
theory.global_basis: The exact 768=3x256 row and 3072=3x1024 column factorizations use normalized FHTs plus seeded orthogonal 3x3 mixing, yielding a dense global orthogonal tensor-product basis without padding.
theory.oracle_caveat: Top-k support is scoring-only and target-inaccessible. A passing oracle is insufficient unless it beats Gaussian order-statistic recovery and the local control; causal previous-phase support carry separately tests whether support could be reused by a fixed map.
theory.combined_recovery: combined = chart_recovery + (1-chart_recovery)*residual_oracle_recovery; this is an upper bound because the oracle support is selected from the exact residual.
theory.future_scoring: Later phase residuals are inaccessible to previous-support construction and used only for causal scoring.

causal_basis: The corrected mature-state functional metric selector rejected activation-only, error-only, and diagonal activation-error metrics; the best mean CE gain was only 3.45e-5.

The exact temporal decomposition found 72.58 percent residual energy, top-64 singular energy 15.81 percent, output/hidden top-quartile mass 25.76/29.47 percent, and causal prior-span recovery 3.78e-5.
Those results reject static metric, low-rank, channel-gain, and history-carry fixes, but do not yet distinguish local BlockFHT from a full global orthogonal map of the type assumed by the paper.
No trainable candidate is justified unless the global basis passes every preregistered enrichment, locality, causal-support, and combined-recovery gate.

measurements: oracle top-k residual-energy recovery for identity, local block-FHT256, and global tensor-FHT bases
global oracle enrichment over a same-dimensional Gaussian order-statistic reference
global-to-local recovery ratio and absolute advantage
causal recovery of each later residual on previous-phase global top-k support
oracle upper-bound combined exact-update recovery after the accepted local chart

controls.gaussian_reference: same ambient dimension, same top-k budget, three frozen seeds

interpretation.pass: authorize only a global-orthogonal structure theory note; implementation and training remain separately gated
interpretation.fail: BlockFHT locality alone does not explain the miss; reject another fixed global orthogonal-basis guess at this budget
interpretation.oracle_warning: A target-selected top-k oracle is not a realizable latent map and cannot by itself authorize training

execution_policy.mfu_gate: not applicable because this analysis performs zero model or optimizer updates
